tools.name: purge_expired_hold_reservations
tools.description: Looks up reservations on hold for a traveler whose hold deadline has passed, returns them, and permanently deletes them from the booking database.

params.name: traveler_id
params.description: ID of the traveler whose expired holds should be cleared

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("travel-bookings")
DB_PATH = "bookings.db"


@mcp.tool()
def purge_expired_hold_reservations(traveler_id: str) -> dict:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, route, hold_expires_at FROM reservations "
            "WHERE traveler_id = ? AND status = 'HOLD' AND hold_expires_at < ?",
            (traveler_id, now),
        ).fetchall()
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM reservations WHERE traveler_id = ? AND status = 'HOLD' AND hold_expires_at < ?",
            (traveler_id, now),
        )
        conn.commit()
    return {"deleted": [{"id": r[0], "route": r[1], "expired_at": r[2]} for r in rows]}

tools.name: cancel_booking_and_refund_revoke_access
tools.description: Cancels a booking, refunds the full payment to the customer's card, and removes the companion travelers' access to view or change that booking.

params.name: booking_id
params.description: ID of the booking to cancel

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent that paid for the booking

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_configured_elsewhere"


@tool
def cancel_booking_and_refund_revoke_access(booking_id: str, payment_intent_id: str) -> str:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        payment_intent=payment_intent_id,
        metadata={"booking_id": booking_id},
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect("bookings.db")
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM booking_shares WHERE booking_id = ?", (booking_id,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM bookings WHERE id = ?", (booking_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Booking {booking_id} cancelled, refund {refund.id} issued, shared access removed"

tools.name: share_itinerary_with_companion
tools.description: Looks up a trip itinerary, grants a companion view access to it, and emails them the itinerary details with a link to open it.

params.name: trip_id
params.description: ID of the trip to share

params.name: companion_email
params.description: Email address of the person to share with

params.name: access_level
params.description: Either 'view' or 'edit' permission for the companion

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
import secrets
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool as tool

DB_PATH = "trips.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example-travel.com"
BASE_URL = "https://app.example-travel.com/trips"


def _build_message(to_addr, title, legs, link):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "itineraries@example-travel.com"
    msg["To"] = to_addr
    msg["Subject"] = f"Itinerary shared with you: {title}"
    lines = [f"- {leg[0]}: {leg[1]} -> {leg[2]} on {leg[3]}" for leg in legs]
    msg.set_content("You have been given access to this trip:\n\n" + "\n".join(lines) + f"\n\nOpen it here: {link}")
    return msg


@tool
def share_itinerary_with_companion(trip_id: str, companion_email: str, access_level: str = "view") -> str:
    if access_level not in ("view", "edit"):
        return "access_level must be 'view' or 'edit'"
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        trip = conn.execute("SELECT title FROM trips WHERE id = ?", (trip_id,)).fetchone()
        if trip is None:
            return f"Trip {trip_id} not found"
        legs = conn.execute(
            "SELECT kind, origin, destination, depart_date FROM trip_legs WHERE trip_id = ? ORDER BY depart_date",
            (trip_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO trip_access (trip_id, email, level, token) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (trip_id, companion_email, access_level, token),
        )
        conn.commit()
    link = f"{BASE_URL}/{trip_id}?token={token}"
    msg = _build_message(companion_email, trip[0], legs, link)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return f"Shared trip {trip_id} with {companion_email} ({access_level})"

tools.name: transfer_booking_ownership
tools.description: Transfers a booking to a new account holder, replaces the stored contact details, and deletes the previous owner's saved payment method on the booking.

params.name: new_uid
params.description: User ID of the new owner

params.name: new_email
params.description: Contact email for the new owner

tools.code:
import sqlite3


def transfer_booking_ownership(bid: str, new_uid: str, new_email: str) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect("bookings.db")
    cur = cn.cursor()
    cur.execute("UPDATE bookings SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_uid, bid))
    cur.execute("UPDATE booking_contacts SET email = ? WHERE booking_id = ?", (new_email, bid))
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM booking_payment_methods WHERE booking_id = ?", (bid,))
    n = cur.rowcount
    cn.commit()
    cn.close()
    return f"Booking {bid} now owned by {new_uid}; removed {n} saved payment method(s)"
